title: How Liquid built its core engineering team with Contrario
summary: When Liquid hired its first in-person engineer, the company was just its founder and a few contractors. Contrario placed that engineer, and every core engineering hire that followed, as Liquid grew from an early-stage startup into a Series A company.
body_markdown:
Liquid is a fintech company building a unified trading platform that gives retail traders leveraged access to crypto and other markets through a single interface. Founded by Franklyn Wang, a former quantitative researcher at Two Sigma, the company raised a Paradigm-led seed round and has since closed an $18M Series A.


Contrario placed Liquid's first in-person engineer when the company was still just Wang and a handful of contractors, and stayed on as its engineering hiring partner through everything that followed.
